verification_commands.ac4:
set -u
F=docs/criteria/scoring_map/delivery.md
test -f "$F" || { echo "ac4 RED: $F missing - the card's only deliverable"; exit 1; }
H2=$(tr -d '\r' < README.md | grep -cE "^## [^#]")
T=$(tr -d '\r' < README.md | wc -l | tr -d " ")
echo "ac4 evidence: README as found lines=$T h2=$H2"
case "$H2" in 17|18) : ;; *) echo "ac4 RED: README carries $H2 level-2 headings - t114 writes zero README bytes; if the count moved the merge window is entangled"; exit 1 ;; esac
if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  CH=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- README.md docs/state/merge_test_index.json openapi.yaml render.yaml Dockerfile docker-compose.yml backend frontend e2e ops observability incident-response .github docs/plan.md docs/backlog.md AGENTS.md Makefile docs/criteria/agent_pack_verification.md docs/criteria/req_coverage_verification.md docs/criteria/dashboard_verification.md docs/criteria/infra_verification.md docs/criteria/security_ops_verification.md docs/criteria/docs_verification.md | grep -c .)
  [ "$CH" = "0" ] || { echo "ac4 RED: $CH tracked files changed outside t114's surface - docs/criteria/scoring_map/delivery.md is the ONLY write surface this card owns, and .github/workflows belongs to t119, not here"; git diff --name-only HEAD | sed 's/^/    /'; exit 1; }
  UT=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -vE '^docs/criteria/scoring_map/(process|app|delivery|telemetry)[.]md$|^docs/issues/(groom/)?t114[.]md$|^docs/state/outputs/t114_.*[.]json$|^scratch/|^build/|^docs/state/history/|node_modules' | grep -c .)
  [ "$UT" = "0" ] || { echo "ac4 RED: untracked files appeared outside the owned surface:"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -vE '^docs/criteria/scoring_map/(process|app|delivery|telemetry)[.]md$|^docs/issues/(groom/)?t114[.]md$|^docs/state/outputs/t114_.*[.]json$|^scratch/|^build/|^docs/state/history/|node_modules' | sed 's/^/    /'; exit 1; }
  echo "ac4 evidence: zero changed tracked files and zero untracked files outside the owned surface"
fi
for sfx in process app telemetry; do
  if [ -f "docs/criteria/scoring_map/$sfx.md" ]; then
    cmp -s "$F" "docs/criteria/scoring_map/$sfx.md" && { echo "ac4 RED: delivery.md is byte-identical to $sfx.md - a duplicated record is not a verification record"; exit 1; }
  fi
done
grep -qiE "TODO|TBD|placeholder" "$F" && { echo "ac4 RED: the record carries a placeholder token - 'promote.yml lands with t119' is forbidden; if promote.yml is not on the tree at build time the record states the gate it points at and the orchestrator sequences the merge, it does not write a future tense"; exit 1; }
# no secret material may be echoed into a criteria record, even a fake one
grep -qiE "rh_[a-z0-9]{10,}|x-api-key: [a-z0-9]{8,}|RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK=[^ \$]" "$F" && { echo "ac4 RED: the record contains something that looks like hook material - the hook URL lives only in the RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK secret (REQ-CICD-070) and is never written into a document"; exit 1; }
echo "ac4 GREEN: ZERO-BYTE PURITY - delivery.md is the only write surface; README (17 H2, $T lines), the merge index, the product tree, all four workflow files, the other criteria reports and both frozen yaml surfaces carry zero bytes from t114; no placeholder token and no secret-shaped string"
